# Added with corpus/edit (ADR 0012, P3b step E1): four mutated windows of that suite. Three are a double-quoted scalar that continues on a line less indented than its key
# or after another entry (`name: "alpha` / `count: 3` / `  beta"`): yaml.v3 folds it into one string, saphyr refuses it (YAML_SYNTAX). The fourth is a `?` inside a plain scalar of a
# flow mapping (`{gateway: g?1, ...}`): Rust reads it as text, yaml.v3 refuses it. Both are classes that are already open (docs/P1-SUPPORTED-SUBSET.md, Parser parity); block context
# with the scalar on its own indented continuation agrees. They matter for the editor: P3b never edits a multi-line scalar (EDIT_MULTILINE_SCALAR) and the scanner of step E2 reads only
# what both parsers accept.
